gloss: to be see-through; to be transparent

definitions.gloss: to be transparent; to be see-through
definitions.explanation: Describes when something can be seen through another material, or when underlying things become visible.

definitions.gloss: to show through; to be visible
definitions.explanation: When something beneath or behind becomes visible through a surface or covering.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{服|ふく}が{透|す}けて{下着|したぎ}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: The white clothes are see-through and the underwear is visible.

examples.japanese: {薄|うす}い{紙|かみ}から{光|ひかり}が{透|す}けて{見|み}える。
examples.english: Light can be seen through the thin paper.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{肌|はだ}は{白|しろ}くて、{血管|けっかん}が{透|す}けて{見|み}えるほどだ。
examples.english: Her skin is so pale that you can see her veins through it.

notes:
{透|す}ける is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) describing when something is transparent or see-through. There is no direct transitive pair.

ASPECT ({ている}):
{透|す}けている indicates an ongoing state of being see-through or transparent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {光|ひかり}が{透|す}ける - light shows through
- {肌|はだ}が{透|す}ける - skin is translucent
- {透|す}けて{見|み}える - to be visible through (something)

RELATED WORDS:
- {透明|とうめい} - transparent (adjective)
- {透|す}かす - to look through, to hold up to light (transitive)
